issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מְשֻׁלָּם' (Meshullam) is rendered as '梅書蘭姆人' (adding '人' = 'person of'), and 'מִיָּמִן' (from the right hand / from Yamin) is rendered as '米雅明' (Miyamin), which appears to be a different name. The Hebrew has 'Meshullam, Abijah, from Yamin' — likely a list of names, not 'Meshullam the Abijah from Miyamin'. The rendering '亞比亞' for 'אֲבִיָּה' (Abijah) is acceptable, but '出自米雅明' misidentifies 'מִיָּמִן' as a place/personal name 'Miyamin' rather than the Hebrew phrase 'from the right hand' (or possibly a clan name 'Yamin'). The addition of '人' and the rendering '米雅明' constitute a name/meaning swap.
